Requirement: Either party must give ninety (90) days written notice to prevent automatic renewal.
The Provider shall host and operate the Customer's shipment tracking platform, including the web portal, public API, and nightly data exports.
The Provider shall maintain 99.9% monthly availability for the production environment, excluding scheduled maintenance announced 72 hours in advance.
Severity 1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes.
Severity 1 incidents must be resolved or mitigated within 4 hours.
Severity 2 incidents must be acknowledged within 1 hour.
If availability falls below 99.9%, the Customer is entitled to a credit of 10% of the monthly fee for each full 0.5% below the target, capped at 50%.
The Provider shall deliver a monthly service report by the fifth business day of each month covering availability, incidents, and open change requests.
All Customer data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256.
All Customer data must be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The Provider shall notify the Customer of any confirmed security breach affecting Customer data within 24 hours of discovery.
Customer data shall be stored only in data centers located in the European Union.
Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.
Late payments may accrue interest of 1% per month.
Either party may terminate for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice.
